thread:
liam: quick note  brought up a converted Llama->Gemma int4 build and saw weird headwise artifacts in chat evals: occasional sudden stop and then a block of repeating subwords.

anya: any conversion flags?

liam: `python convert.py --src llama-7b --dst gemma-layout --int4 --fold-rotary --headperm rotate_by4`

benchbot: auto-eval 4923456789: chat-coherency F1 0.81 -> 0.62, repeat-rate 0.03 -> 0.22, latency improved

oliver: rotate_by4 permutes projection order — did we also rotate the rotary index table? that mismatch causes phase misalignment and repeat bursts.

liam: i dumped attention maps and saw paired heads diverge after ~120 tokens. local fix: rotate rotary indices by same offset as proj permute and repeats drop to 0.05.

anya: please file PR to convert.py to carry `rotary_map` when applying headperm and add a small regression test in `tests/onboard/` that runs 256-token chat and checks repeat-rate < 0.06. tagging @oliver
